body:
Closed the named 'next frontier' from the prior self-hosting session: selfhost/emit.prn now emits real #target {:c (inline-c ...)} whole-body FFI functions, a direct port of the reference compiler's find_target_c_src/emit_target_defn. Live-verified through the real parena-selfhost binary end to end. A real self-compilation attempt (parena-selfhost building its own 8-file source set) surfaced the precise remaining gap list: mid-body #target (a different, separate shape), no scalar I32/F64 return-type support, if-as-whole-body, a struct-literal restriction -- all named honestly in NORTHSTAR.md, none claimed fixed. make test: 347/347. Commit 8822b52.

⚓ ☃
title: Selfhost: whole-body #target/inline-c FFI emission support shipped
